profile.headline: Software Engineer at Knight-Swift Supply Chain
profile.summary: Versatile Software Engineer with comprehensive skills and knowledge in ETL solutions (Python, Airflow), WebDev tech (TS, React, Nest.js, Prisma), .NET (C#, .NET MAUI, .NET Framework, .NET Core), Databases (T-SQL, PostgreSQL), DevOps (Azure DevOps, CI/CD, Docker, Git), Testing frameworks (Cucumber, Playwright, Selenium), and Shell scripting (PowerShell, Bash) who take value in producing quality work and products.

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
Develop assistive software technologies for warehouse management and warehouse workers.

Developed the label printing helper software for the IT department using .NET C# and the .NET MAUI framework that is being used by the help desk technicians to print thousands of labels every day with ease, saving them hundreds of hours each month.

Developed and laid the foundation for the low-code application building solution, using React (Next.js) and Nest.js, which is used in production today for building new applications for warehouse needs.

Built data-transfer DAGs using Airflow and Python from scratch that are used in production to transfer/migrate the order data from one system to another.

Helped build an entire QA framework that does automatic regression testing on any new code changes from any of the main projects at the company, using Cucumber, Playwright, PowerShell, and Azure Pipelines templating (with YAML-based pipelines).

Effectively managed and maintained Azure DevOps build and release pipelines, building YAML-based build pipelines and classic release pipelines for a smooth CI/CD workflow for the team.

Built and deployed projects from the ground up using Docker Compose.

Paved the way for our entire development team to version-control our T-SQL codebase (using RedGate, Git, and Azure DevOps) and allowed the team to efficiently push code, while also giving them the ability to review any new T-SQL code changes and to revert or fix issues before they affected production easily.

Wrote many shell scripts, such as PowerShell or Bash scripts, to automate many of the development processes and workflows.
